newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Six killed in bus crash in Azerbaijan.
newsitem.headline: Six killed in bus crash in Azerbaijan.

text.p: Six people have been killed and nine injured in a bus crash in the former Soviet republic of Azerbaijan, Interfax news agency reported on Wednesday.
Quoting Azeri officials, Interfax said the crash, which took place in the remote Geok-Cai district late on Tuesday, was the fault of the driver, who was among the injured.
The bus had been carrying agricultural workers home from work but no further details were available.
